answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by treating influence as a delayed echo of independently attested work, not a free headcount. Each new identity posts a slashable anchor bond that remains locked until several epochs of unique, non-reusable answers survive review. Those answers are passed through a grading prism of separate panels—originality, mechanism, and consistency—and only the intersection mints weight. Copied or farmed text fails a facet, so extra keys cannot stack voting power.
